pages.text: Real-world time and date, in the time zone of the server:

$(li)NOW: the current time as a TIME value$(li)YEAR, MONTH, DAY: parts of the date$(li)HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND, MILLISECOND: parts of the time$(li)WEEKDAY: 1 for Monday up to 7 for Sunday$(li)WEEK: the week of the year$(li)TIMER: seconds since midnight$(li)SLEEP: wait for a number of game ticks
The date and time functions use the current time, or a TIME value you pass as $(1)time$(). SLEEP waits between 1 and 72000 ticks.
